name: Verdant Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, newly awakened night elf druids receive a summons to begin their training. Conservator Ilthalaine gives them the Verdant Sigil for Mardant Strongoak inside Aldrassil, where their study of nature and the Emerald Dream begins.

sections.title: A Call to the Boughs
sections.body: When a young night elf shows promise in keeping Shadowglen's balance, the order calls for a formal introduction. A runner brings the Verdant Sigil to Conservator Ilthalaine. She entrusts it to the initiate, showing that the circle in Aldrassil has taken notice and inviting the young druid to begin formal training.

sections.title: Communion and the Dream
sections.body: Present the sigil to Mardant Strongoak inside Aldrassil, and the initiate is welcomed into the fold. Deeper communion with the Emerald Dream and mastery of animal forms lie ahead. For now, Mardant becomes their first guide, teaching them to read nature's spirits and channel the raw power of the woods.

faq.answer: The Verdant Sigil is an inscribed summons that Conservator Ilthalaine delivers on Mardant Strongoak's behalf. It calls a novice druid to begin formal training inside Aldrassil.

faq.q: Where do I take the Verdant Sigil?
faq.answer: Bring the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer inside Aldrassil. The great barrow-tree stands at the heart of Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why does Mardant mention the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Mardant mentions the Emerald Dream because druids draw power and wisdom from it through long sleeping trances. A novice is not ready to wander the Dream freely, but will study its mysteries in time.

faq.q: Who sends the sigil to Ilthalaine?
faq.answer: A messenger sent by Mardant Strongoak brings the sigil to Conservator Ilthalaine. He can then place it in the hands of a promising young druid.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil?
faq.answer: Mardant Strongoak becomes your primary mentor in Shadowglen. You learn your earliest druidic spells and magical techniques as you grow in power.
No. The Verdant Sigil is meant only for night elf druids beginning their journey in Shadowglen. Other classes receive their own summons to their trainers.

angles.text: As a druid, you begin the formal study of the Cenarion circle's teachings under Mardant Strongoak. The long path toward understanding the Emerald Dream lies ahead.
As a night elf, you enter an ancient tradition. Presenting the sigil at Aldrassil is your first step into druidism, deeply woven into your culture.
